description_en: Supports detecting all key fields on the waybill.
description_zh: 支持识别面单上所有关键字段
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-waybill --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1lOe6VqL7gK0jSZFBXXXZZpXa-480-640.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeWaybill

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
